priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts still registers handler with socket.on("message", handler) at line 2, while the PR changes the returned disposer at line 3 from socket.off("message", handler) to a no-op. The exact same head therefore still invokes and retains the handler after cleanup; this is reassessed as P1 because ordinary attach/dispose use violates the cleanup contract and can cause post-teardown callbacks and duplicate processing.
